# featureflip_project (Resource)

A Featureflip project. Import with `terraform import featureflip_project.example <project-key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "featureflip_project" "web" {
  key         = "web"
  name        = "Web App"
  description = "Customer-facing web application"

  # Temporary flags with no expires_at of their own count as expired after 90 days.
  default_flag_lifetime_days = 90
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Immutable project key (changing it replaces the project).
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `default_flag_lifetime_days` (Number) Days a temporary flag with no expires_at of its own lives before it counts as expired (1–3650), or `0` to remove the default. Advisory only: evaluation never changes. Omitting it leaves the default unmanaged: whatever is set in the dashboard is kept. Reads as `0` when the project has no default.
- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import featureflip_project.web web
```
